original.target_description: Meyer et al. (2013), study 1, Go/no-go task, ERN at FCz internal consistency at 12 error trials. Selected direct-replication reliability target; exact intended outcome/test is not uniquely identified by supplied task-only locator.

n.sample_role: participants contributing to the selected task-specific ERN coefficient-alpha estimate
n.exclusions: 47 recruited; 2 excluded for fewer than six errors in at least one task and 2 for excessive EEG artifacts; final sample 43. At 20 errors 41 remained for flanker/Stroop and 40 for go/no-go.
n.location: p. 1221, Participants and Data Analysis (full sample available through first 14 error trials)
n.quote: The final sample consisted of 43 participants (19 female). [...] the full sample was only available when calculating alpha using the first 14 error trials.

es.quote: Cronbach’s alpha achieved moderate reliability (.70) after 12 errors

replication.target_description: Holbrook et al., supplied xr6bn preprint, study 1, Aim 1 direct replication, Go/no-go ERN coefficient alpha at 12 error trials.

n.sample_role: participants contributing to the selected task-specific ERN coefficient-alpha estimate
n.exclusions: 205 recruited; 23 with fewer than six artifact-free error trials in any task excluded, leaving 182. Further task-specific availability depends on trial cutoff.
n.quote: The number of participants available to calculate α for the go/no-go task at 12 trials was 172.

es.quote: α for go/no-go ERN scores reached 0.61 (95% CI: 0.51, 0.69)

reported_success.quote: Thus, hypothesis #1 was supported for the go/no-go task.

notes: Both retrieved primary full texts have titles and authors matching the assigned references. Supplied replication p. 40 contains references in the retrieved 73-page preprint; task-specific direct replication results are on p. 15. The task-only descriptions do not identify outcome, trial count, or statistical contrast, and request d although these direct-replication results report coefficient alpha. target_match remains null because exact intended test cannot be established. Selected the direct-replication ERN reliability target corresponding to the original discussion near p. 1223. No d conversion performed. No p value is reported for the selected alpha estimates; confidence intervals are not p values. Original/repl sample sizes refer to the selected trial cutoffs, not generic recruitment totals. Original .70 is the printed approximate reliability threshold reached after 12 errors, not an independently tabulated exact coefficient.
